name: Thai Lotus
description: Thai Lotus is a family-owned Thai restaurant at the Botanic Gardens end of Dean Street in Albury. The kitchen serves traditional Thai cuisine across an extensive menu of curries, stir-fries and salads. Dine in, takeaway and delivery are all offered, with lunch and dinner service Tuesday to Saturday.
highlights: Lunch and dinner Tuesday to Saturday

name: Downtown Pizzeria
description: Downtown Pizzeria is a wood fired pizza and Italian restaurant on Dean Street, established in 2015. The menu covers pizzas, pastas, salads, entrees and sharing plates, with produce sourced locally. Vegan, gluten free and dairy free options are available, and the venue serves cocktails and local wines alongside dine in, takeaway and function bookings.
highlights: Vegan, gluten free and dairy free options

name: Level One Wine Bar
description: Level One Wine Bar is an upstairs wine bar and restaurant with bay windows looking over Dean Street. It stocks more than 300 wines on a wall-of-wine, with 15 or more available by the glass and the selection rotating every three weeks. Head chef Matt King runs a regularly updated seasonal menu built on fresh local produce, and the bar also pours beers and cocktails.
highlights: 15+ wines by the glass, rotating every three weeks
Seasonal menu by head chef Matt King
Beers and cocktails as well as wine

name: Indian Tandoori Restaurant Albury
description: Indian Tandoori Restaurant has been trading in Albury since 1998 and specialises in traditional North Indian and Goan cuisine. The menu changes from time to time and is cooked by qualified chefs from India, with tandoor baked meats and breads a focus. Lunch is served Tuesday to Sunday and dinner seven nights.
highlights: Opposite the cinema on Dean Street

name: Authentic Taste of India
description: Authentic Taste of India is a family owned restaurant on Dean Street next to the cinemas, run by Charanjit and Ramandeep Bhullar. The kitchen serves fare from northern India with an emphasis on tandoori dishes and curries made with fresh local produce. Dine in and takeaway are both available, with lunch service Thursday to Sunday.
highlights: Northern Indian tandoori dishes and curries
Next to the cinemas on Dean Street
Lunch Thursday to Sunday, dinner seven nights

name: Sen
description: Sen is a Vietnamese fine dining restaurant on Olive Street in central Albury. The menu draws on North, Central and South Vietnamese traditions using seasonal local ingredients and contemporary technique, with dishes such as Nha Trang cuttlefish and grilled pork jowl. Dinner is served Tuesday to Saturday from 5.30pm.
highlights: Dishes from North, Central and South Vietnam

name: Din Dins
description: Din Dins is an Asian fusion restaurant on Townsend Street in Albury, with a menu drawing on Chinese, Thai, Japanese and other Asian influences given a contemporary twist. Attached to the restaurant is the Panda Room, an 80 seat private function room with its own bar and kitchen. Lunch is served Wednesday to Saturday and dinner Tuesday to Saturday.
highlights: Panda Room private function space with its own bar
Cocktails, beer on tap and an extensive wine list

name: Vanilla Pod Pizza & Pasta Bar Albury
description: Vanilla Pod Pizza & Pasta Bar has been trading on Dean Street since 2018 as a family dining restaurant. The kitchen makes woodfired pizza and handmade pasta and also serves breakfast, premium steaks, seafood, desserts and kids' meals alongside coffee. Breakfast, lunch and dinner are served daily, with takeaway and online ordering available.

name: Canvas Eatery
description: Canvas Eatery sits behind the Murray Art Museum Albury overlooking QEII Square and has been trading since 2015. The kitchen runs a seasonal menu built around produce from the Riverina and Murray regions, and the room is a light filled space attached to the gallery. Specialty coffee is served alongside the food menu.

name: Taco Bill Albury
description: Taco Bill Albury is a Mexican restaurant on Dean Street serving tacos, enchiladas, fajitas, quesadillas and burritos. The venue is fully licensed and does not permit BYO. There is a children's menu plus vegan and coeliac options, and both dine in and takeaway are offered, with service from 5pm Wednesday to Sunday.

name: Thai Puka Restaurant
description: Thai Puka cooks Thai food drawn from the owners' childhood in Nan in northern Thailand, running true Thai favourites alongside evolving specials. The 85 seat restaurant is fully licensed with a wine list, beers and cocktails, and offers alfresco dining and air conditioning. Pad Thai noodles are the dish it is best known for, and vegetarian and gluten free options are available.
highlights: Cooking from Nan in northern Thailand
Fully licensed with wine, beer and cocktails

name: Indian Chimney
description: Indian Chimney has been on Dean Street since 2010 serving North Indian and regional Indian dishes, including clay oven baked breads. The menu covers entrees, mains, rice and naan and desserts with both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options. The venue has a refurbished dining area with outdoor seating, and offers in-store pickup plus local delivery to Albury, Wodonga and Thurgoona.
highlights: Delivery to Albury, Wodonga and Thurgoona

name: Albury Chinese Restaurant
description: Albury Chinese Restaurant serves standard Cantonese-style dishes and yum cha from an open dining room on Dean Street. Sizzling plates, beef dishes, dim sum and Peking duck feature on the menu, along with value meal packages. The restaurant is fully licensed and offers dine in, outdoor seating and takeaway.
highlights: Yum cha and Chinese à la carte
Sizzling plates, dim sum and Peking duck
Dine in, outdoor seating and takeaway

name: Baan Sabai Jai Thai Restaurant
description: Baan Sabai Jai has been serving Thai food on Smollett Street in Albury since 2009. The menu runs to traditional Thai curries and house specialties, with lunch service midweek and a Sunday daytime sitting. Dine in, pickup and delivery are all offered.

name: AIDA Mediterranean Cuisine & Bar
description: AIDA is a Mediterranean restaurant and bar on Dean Street in Albury cooking from traditional recipes. An outdoor charcoal grill drives much of the menu, which is built around chargrilled dishes and plates designed for sharing. Cocktails, a curated wine list and vegetarian options are also offered, with lunch and dinner Wednesday to Sunday.
highlights: Lunch and dinner Wednesday to Sunday

name: Argos Albury
description: Argos is a modern wood-fired Greek restaurant on Smollett Street in Albury. Cooking is done over a wood-fired charcoal oven using fresh ingredients, with a menu of shareable plates. Signature cocktails are served alongside the food.

name: South Albury Take Away
description: South Albury Take Away is a traditional fish and chip shop on Ebden Street that has been trading since 2000. Chips are hand cut from fresh potatoes, and the fish counter runs varieties including hake, flake and flounder plus other seafood. It opens early seven days a week.

name: Jones Street Take Away
description: Jones Street Take Away is a traditional fish and chip shop in Albury where the fish and battered products are made fresh rather than pre-battered. Beef patties are made in house from locally produced 100% Australian beef. The shop changes its frying oils regularly and trades six days a week, closed Tuesdays.

name: Borella Seafood
description: Borella Seafood has traded on Electra Street in East Albury since 1987 and runs three parts to the business. There is a fresh seafood counter selling fish fillets, prawns and oysters, a casual fish and chips takeaway, and Scales Restaurant serving contemporary seafood cooking. Stock is hand selected from Melbourne fishmongers.
highlights: Fresh fish, prawns and oysters counter
Stock hand selected from Melbourne fishmongers

name: Saigon Bites
description: Saigon Bites is a Vietnamese restaurant on Kiewa Street in Albury opened by Jess Nguyen and Tony Ngo. Pho and banh xeo have been the popular orders, alongside special fried rice, crispy egg noodles and sugar cane with rice noodles. The room seats around 60 including 36 outdoor seats on Kiewa Street, is fully licensed with cocktails, wines and tap beers, and offers takeaway.
highlights: Fully licensed with cocktails and tap beer

name: The Vietnamese Guy
description: The Vietnamese Guy is a casual licensed Vietnamese eatery on Dean Street in Albury with about 20 seats. The menu covers roast pork banh mi, pho, chicken bao buns, prawn spring rolls and Vietnamese iced coffee, and the kitchen is led by chef Jack. Delivery, takeaway and online ordering are available, with dairy free, gluten free, vegan and vegetarian choices.
highlights: Banh mi, pho and bao buns

name: Miss Amelie
description: Miss Amelie is a modern European restaurant set in the heritage former Wodonga railway station on Elgin Boulevard. The menu is offered as two or three courses plus a six course degustation midweek to Saturday, with vegan and gluten free menus available. An attached cocktail bar called Little Miss serves classic and contemporary drinks, and the venue takes private dining bookings and functions.
highlights: Housed in the heritage former Wodonga railway station
Two and three course menus plus six course degustation

name: Indian Tandoori Restaurant Wodonga
description: Indian Tandoori Restaurant Wodonga is the Stanley Street sibling of the Albury restaurant, trading under the same name since 1998. It cooks traditional North Indian and Goan cuisine, with poultry and meat curries, seafood, tikka and tandoor oven baked meats and breads. Banquets are available and dinner is served seven nights.
highlights: Sister restaurant to Indian Tandoori Albury

name: King of Curries
description: King of Curries is an Indian restaurant on Thomas Mitchell Drive in Wodonga specialising in North Indian cuisine. The menu uses fresh ingredients and authentic recipes with dishes drawn from different regions of India, including tandoori dishes and vegetarian and vegan options. Dinner is served Tuesday to Saturday from 5pm.
highlights: Dishes from different regions of India

name: Phaboonchai Thai Restaurant
description: Phaboonchai is a Thai restaurant on Beechworth Road in Wodonga, established in 2014. The menu covers stir fries, curries and rice dishes along with soups, noodles and salads. Online ordering, table reservations, pick-up and delivery are all offered.
highlights: Stir fries, curries and rice dishes

name: Casa 1872 Italian Ristorante
description: Casa 1872 is an Italian restaurant in a heritage-listed building on High Street in Wodonga, from the team behind Deli Bean Cafe and The Proprietor. The kitchen serves authentic Italian dishes and wood-fired pizza in a rustic dining room. Handcrafted pastas, locally sourced seafood, tiramisu, wine and espresso all feature, and the name refers to the building's history.

name: Chao Thai Wodonga
description: Chao Thai has been trading on High Street in Wodonga since 2002. The restaurant serves a range of Thai dishes in a warm dining room with options for various dietary preferences. It caters for large group functions and takes reservations, with dinner served seven nights.

name: Real Thai Kitchen
description: Real Thai Kitchen has served Thai food on High Street in Wodonga since 2009. The dining room is set with white tablecloths and the kitchen is staffed by experienced chefs using traditional cooking techniques. Weekday lunch is served as well as dinner seven nights, and takeaway and home delivery are available.

name: Wodonga Noodle Canteen
description: Wodonga Noodle Canteen has been trading on High Street for more than 16 years. The menu runs to noodles, stir-fries and rice dishes, with gluten-free and vegetarian choices available. It is a licensed informal restaurant offering dine-in and takeaway, with street parking on High Street and disabled access.

name: La Maison
description: La Maison is a licensed cafe and restaurant on Lincoln Causeway at Gateway Island between Albury and Wodonga. The menu features grass fed steaks, fish, chicken, pork belly and pasta. Tapas, charcuterie and cheese platters and desserts are also served.

name: The Vietnamese Guy Wodonga
description: The Vietnamese Guy opened this High Street shop as a second location after demand from Wodonga locals travelling to the Albury store. The menu includes a selection of pho with both beef and chicken options. The shop is kid friendly with a small play pen, and serves lunch seven days with dinner Wednesday to Saturday.
highlights: Second location of the Albury original
Kid friendly with a small play pen

name: Junction Pizza
description: Junction Pizza is a locally owned and operated pizza, pasta and parmi takeaway shop on High Street in Wodonga. Snacks and desserts are also on the menu. There are sit-in options as well as takeaway.

name: Provenance
description: Provenance is a restaurant with accommodation on Ford Street in Beechworth, run by chef Michael Ryan. The kitchen leans Japanese and builds its tasting menu around local produce, served as bento-style courses made up of many individual plates. Dinner is served Friday to Monday.

name: Ford Street Enoteca
description: Ford Street Enoteca is a long-standing bistro in the centre of Beechworth serving relaxed Italian-leaning food. The kitchen works with fresh seasonal produce through house-made pasta and classic bistro dishes. The wine list is extensive, with a strong selection of local wines alongside international choices, and the room suits both small and larger groups.
highlights: Extensive local and international wine list

name: The Pickled Sisters Cafe + Restaurant
description: The Pickled Sisters is a family-run cafe and restaurant on Rutherglen's Main Street, a fixture in the town for more than 20 years. The kitchen cooks homemade food from locally sourced produce and matches it with regional wines. Brunch, long lunches, vineyard platters, takeaway meals and catering are offered, and Thursday night is pasta night.
highlights: Locally sourced produce and regional wines

name: Thousand Pound
description: Thousand Pound is a wine bar, store and restaurant on Rutherglen's Main Street. Executive chef Jack Cassidy cooks modern Australian food carrying Chinese, Thai, Vietnamese and Nepalese flavours, using produce from the business's own farms and regional growers. Local wines, creative cocktails and craft beers are poured alongside, with dinner Thursday to Saturday and bookings recommended.
highlights: Wine bar, wine store and restaurant
Local wines, cocktails and craft beer
